scientific.integrity: The AdaNorm historical norm is solved exactly on a persistent two-level norm sequence. The correction activation, first corrected low step, asymptotic corrected contrast, and sharp contrast cap follow from closed scalar recurrences.
limitations: Statement concerns AdaNorm's generic gradient-correction front end rather than a host optimizer's final parameter update.
Gradient directions are unrestricted but can matter after the wrapper.
The cap is asymptotic rather than a first-iteration guarantee.

title: AdaNorm has a sharp two-level gradient-contrast cap
